params.prompt: Continuous 12-second cinematic shot, dark warm bakery counter, camera slowly dollies from left to right along four workstations, no cuts, steady speed. Station 1 (0-3s): an open recipe notebook, a hand turns a page, honey jar and flour bowl beside it. Station 2 (3-6s): a steel bowl, a wooden spoon folds dough, a little flour dust in the air. Station 3 (6-9s): thin round cake layers are stacked with cream, the top layer settles into place. Station 4 (9-12s): a piping bag decorates a finished layered honey cake, crumbs and a honey drizzle, warm spotlight. Photoreal, shallow depth of field, matte dark surfaces, deep coffee-brown shadows, single warm key light, subtle yellow rim glow, hands only, no faces, no text, no logos, no watermark.
